title: Private Use Allowed on a Suspended Listing between Readings
content:
A Keyturn Vehicle Listing that is suspended is still a vehicle the host may drive, and private use is allowed against the booked stretch. How much turns on how long it is since the most recent odometer record.

1. A vehicle whose listing is suspended and whose most recent odometer record is more than 30 calendar days before the handling date is allowed 250 miles of private use against the booked stretch.

2. A vehicle whose listing is suspended with an odometer record within 30 calendar days is allowed 125 miles.

3. Any other vehicle is allowed none on this ground, an allowance of 0 miles.

### Points of judgement

*The suspension is the gate.* A listing in any standing other than suspended falls to the third clause, however long it is since its most recent odometer record.

*At the day boundary.* Where the listing is suspended, an odometer record dated exactly 30 calendar days before the handling date is within the window and allows 125 miles; one dated 31 calendar days before it allows 250 miles.
